title: Towards Benchmarking Power-Performance Characteristics of Federated Learning Clients
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper benchmarks power-performance characteristics of Federated Learning clients, not aspects of religion or faith.
findings: Not applicable. The paper's findings are related to the energy consumption of Federated Learning clients under different power modes and baseloads, with no mention of or relation to religion.
